processing.ingredient_select: One short dry wood contact (0-.095s, speed1.08, HP140/LP1800) and damped glass body (0-.105s, speed.83, HP150/LP1350) at0.02s/gain.22. No paper, water or chime.
processing.ingredient_add: Dry entry touch, rounded recorded splash (0.023-.205s at.94 speed), falling 270->155Hz liquid-body tone and one low secondary droplet at.245s. Drop motion, not a bottle collision.
processing.ingredient_remove: Light recorded water lift (0.275-.435s at1.05 speed), small rising 190->330Hz body, two separated synthetic low droplets at.17/.25s, soft return-to-tray contact at.315s. Different event order from insertion.
processing.word_add: Soft single paper fold (bookFlip2 .046-.200s, speed.94, HP140/LP1900), quiet falling 420->270Hz resonance at.11s, small supported paper landing at.205s. No bright metallic edge.
processing.word_remove: One smooth paper extraction (bookFlip1 .310-.505s, speed1.08, HP170/LP2200) and restrained rising 250->390Hz resonance. Longer open-ended gesture than the short withdrawal return.
processing.word_withdraw: Short dry slip followed by supported paper return (bookPlace2 .034-.144s) at.065s, with a quiet low settling touch at.13s. No watery sound, rising resonance or rejection beep. Alternative word-removal entry, never stack with word_remove.
processing.draft_clear: One combined gathering gesture: muted paper at0, a quiet reversed water lift at.08s, a descending 250->125Hz body at.18s, and one supported settle at.36s. Not a pileup of all individual removal sounds; all-item clear plays once.

synthesis: Deterministic low sine/inharmonic-body tones with short envelopes and frequency gestures. No generated noise beds or finished library SFX used as-is.
common_processing: Selected recordings, mono downmix, polyphase speed change, 2-pole HP and6-pole LP, smoothed local peak suppression, soft edge fades; conservative per-event RMS target and peak ceiling.
dependencies: Python, numpy, scipy, soundfile. Existing local soundfile path is a fallback; no installation performed.
